title: 第26章：佐证
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
无人扶我青云志，我自踏雪至山巅。

    马超看着这群小屁孩嗷嗷的朝家里跑，就好像看见了无数的野菜。

    “大哥，我也想去挖野菜。”

    “你去干什么？”

    马强支支吾吾，就差把想吃糖几个字写在他脸上。

    马超笑了笑，“放心，待会事情还不少，只要好好做，大哥一样给你糖吃。”

    “谢谢大哥。”

    马强高兴的连连点头，小孩子就是这样，情绪来的快去的也快。

    “行了，你们两个看着家，我到大队长家借杆秤，一会就回来。”

    “好的大哥。”

    马超叮嘱完弟弟妹妹，转身就去了大队长家。

    ……

    与此同时。

    有关马超家发达的消息，在村里愈演愈烈。

    起因还要从有人看见，马超拿回来猪肉和粮食说起。

    这年代家家都不富裕，能吃的起肉的时候，掰着手指头都能数的出来。
content_en:
No one helped me to reach the top of the mountain by walking on the snow.

    Ma Chao looked at these little kids running towards home howling, as if he had seen countless wild vegetables.

    "Brother, I also want to dig wild vegetables."

    "What are you going to do?"

    Ma Qiang hesitated, almost writing the words "want to eat sweets" on his face.

    Ma Chao smiled and said, "Don't worry, there will be a lot to do later. As long as you do it well, big brother will give you sweets."

    "Thank you, brother."

    Ma Qiang nodded happily. Children are like this, their emotions come and go quickly.

    "Okay, you two look after your home. I'll go to the captain's house to borrow a scale and I'll be back in a minute."

    "Okay big brother."

    After Ma Chao warned his younger brothers and sisters, he turned around and went to the captain's house.

    ……

    at the same time.

    News about the prosperity of Ma Chao's family became more and more intense in the village.

    The reason also started when someone saw Ma Chao bringing back pork and grain.

    In this era, everyone is not rich, and you can count them on your fingers when they can afford meat.
